method: Manual inspection of the outer plate and printed badge boundaries, approximately frontal photograph. Uniform physical scaling yields a badge about 75 mm high, centred around x=92 mm and y=73 mm on a 300×150 mm blank. The photograph aspect differs from the assumed blank by about 1.5%; no independent x/y contour stretch is used.
uncertainty: Boundaries approximately ±3 source pixels; no camera or lens calibration. Placement is a source-guided estimate, not factory dimensions.
preserved: All supplied badge paths, viewBox and negative spaces. Only the issued preset placement changes; the prototype awaits its own photograph calibration.
